changelog: New app package ai.antigem: AntiGem now runs its own Linux environment, the separate com.termux build is no longer needed
Added rootfs v2 (Nov 19) with a choice of GitHub or Hugging Face download, and a link to each page to download the zip by hand
Added on-the-fly rewriting of Termux packages for AntiGem, so pkg/apt installs work under the new package name
Added Skills and Plugins management for Codex, OpenCode and Claude: install, update and remove from GitHub
Added Setup with AI for skill and plugin repositories that cannot be added directly
Added project checkpoints: snapshot a project and restore it later
Added agent memory and chat history screens
Added STEM rendering: math, chemistry notation and figures in chat
Added m3u8 (HLS) video playback in chat
Added website analysis tools and browser connection settings in REA
Added crash screen with details to report the crash
Added GitHub issue templates for bugs, crashes, install problems, agents and feature requests
Fixed chat crashes when a web view renderer died, chat web views are now cached and reused
Improved file search and file tree speed, with symlink support
Improved mini app permissions: hidden folders handling and official app verification
Improved Android dev, REA and X11 desktop setup to work with the new package name
Improved chat context instructions for the agents
Improved anonymous install and update counting, session tracking is off
